title: tww-2008-troy-windham
label: Cameron Cruise

won.source: The opening roleplay (posted 8 September 2008): PowerMaster takes the Troy Windham title from its namesake and crowns Cameron Cruise 'the TWW Troy Windham Champion'. The owner says the fed's episodes advance the story about a month at a time, so the staged date is the post's.

how: Crowned by the commissioner in a staged ceremony in the fed's opening angle.
note: No `event` link: the title changes hands in a staged angle, not on a card. Later posts call him the TWW World Troy Windham Champion; no post held ends the reign.
